page.layout: One printed title page, centred. Title block at top, then a woodcut engraving in the middle, then the imprint below it.

main_text.l: Scholasticus ex solertissimorum ac sagacissimorum seculi

page.notes: The woodcut engraving between the title and the imprint shows a tree growing from a rocky ground, with a landscape and a town in the background. Figures stand in side columns, one on each side, and a putto sits at the base under a banner. Small roundels at the bottom hold a figure and a ship. A small oval medallion at the top holds a crest. No text in the engraving apart from the banner, which is not legible. The date line reads "cIↄ Iↄ CV" in the scan, read here as MDCV; the scan is not clear enough to be certain. Handwritten "3" and a crossed-out mark in the top right corner are not printed and are left out. The numeral "ANNO" line is set in italic capitals and the imprint is in roman capitals; both are rendered as plain text here.
